title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: The items you named on 6 November are nearly used up, the exit waits for Monday, and 25 points of the week remain to spend before Monday 07:00. May this weekend also take three waiting-list items you did not name: hair that changes colour with distance (Ron and Sheila's goes grey, against your 3 November ruling); worn paint at the edges of Mickey's front; and dressing Ron and Darren in Tom's jeans and jumper, in place of the white base layer?
sections.recommendation: All three, in that order. Each goes in only if it passes a packaged walk by Sunday night's build; otherwise it waits, so Monday's exit judges nothing unwalked. The cost: more runs without your eye, and dressing them departs from your 8 October line that the white layer stays through phase 1; Ron and Darren come to you to look at before anything is copied. Without this, the weekend goes to phase 5's reading, useful but far from the game. No web link: the answer is this page.
options: Hair and paint only, leave the clothes
